title: Melted Crown Portrait
description: A surreal portrait of a young child with a neutral expression, their face partially covered in dripping streams of vibrant orange, blue, green and purple paint. A crumbling, textured mound rests on their head emitting white smoke and floating golden coins, while colorful dots and circular patterns cascade down their neck and shoulders against a dark swirling background.
